title: Medicare Therapy KX Threshold and Targeted Review Amounts — Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services
content:
The compliance office keeps the Medicare therapy threshold amounts that apply to **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services**. The KX modifier threshold is the CMS-published amount of allowed amounts per calendar year; the same amount applies once to physical therapy and speech-language pathology combined and, separately, once to occupational therapy.

## KX modifier threshold by calendar year

| Calendar year | KX threshold (allowed amounts, USD) |
|---|---|
| 2025 | $2410.00 |
| 2026 | $2480.00 |

## Settings by tier

| Tier | Threshold group its allowed amounts count toward | Targeted medical review threshold (allowed amount per threshold group per year) | Services above the KX threshold covered only with medical-necessity documentation in the record | Resident told when allowed amounts reach the KX threshold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care | Physical therapy and speech-language pathology combined | $3000.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care | Occupational therapy | $3000.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care | Physical therapy and speech-language pathology combined | $3000.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care | None | $3000.00 | Yes | No |
| Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care | None | $3000.00 | Yes | No |
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care | None | $3000.00 | Yes | No |

## Reading the table

- **Threshold group.** A Part B physical therapy plan and a Part B speech-language pathology plan count toward the same group; a Part B occupational therapy plan counts toward its own group. The Medicare Advantage, Medical Assistance and Private Pay tiers count toward no KX threshold group.
- **Which year's amount.** The amount is read for the calendar year in question: $2410.00 for 2025 and $2480.00 for 2026.
- **Targeted medical review.** Above $3000.00 of allowed amount per threshold group per year, claims are subject to targeted medical review.
- **Resident notice.** For the three Medicare Part B tiers the resident is told when allowed amounts reach the KX threshold; the other three tiers carry no such notice.

## Basis Q&A

**Is the occupational therapy amount in addition to the combined amount?** Yes. For 2026, for example, physical therapy and speech-language pathology together count against $2480.00, and occupational therapy counts separately against its own $2480.00.

**At what figure does targeted medical review begin for a group?** Above $3000.00 of allowed amount for that group in the year.
